confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are proxies from Cusco, not Ollantaytambo-specific prices. The sources were mostly crowd-sourced Expatistan pages last updated in 2025, plus one travel-budget guide and one 2026 cost-of-living page. No Ollantaytambo menus were found. The wine-by-the-glass figure has no direct local price; it is derived from a Cusco bottle benchmark (about S/30) and the local beer relationship. The cocktail figure rests on a few Cusco bar prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no booking pages or listings were inspected. The FX rate comes from a search summary citing the RBA overview page for 15 October 2026. I did not open that page directly, and third-party sources differed slightly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are anchored to Cusco price points (local draft beer, cappuccino, lunch and set-menu meals, and bar and bottle benchmarks), adjusted upward for Ollantaytambo's tourist-village pricing near Machu Picchu access. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small Sacred Valley tourist town, with the hostel and hotel tiers kept in ascending order.
